title: [Mechanism of polyphyllin A in inhibition of proliferation and induction of apoptosis of gastric cancer cells by directly targeting ETS-1].
authors: Zhang, Liang; Xiong, Yi-Lian; Ren, Yu-Liang; Liu, Xue-Wen; Si, Yuan; Liu, Ying
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物PPA通过分子对接靶向转录因子ETS-1抑制胃癌细胞，虽涉及TF-DNA相关蛋白ETS-1和分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA结合机制，方法仅简单对接，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: The present study investigated the mechanism of polyphyllin A(PPA) in inhibiting gastric cancer(GC) cells. GC cells(SGC7901 and MGC803 cell lines) were treated with PPA at different concentrations. The effect of PPA on the proliferation of GC cells was detected by MTT assay, real-time cell analysis(RTCA) assay, and clone-forming assay, respectively. Reactive oxygen species(ROS) of GC cells was detected by flow cytometry. The change of mitochondrial membrane potential was detected by JC-1 assay. The expression and phosphorylation levels of apoptosis-related proteins(caspase-9, caspase-3, and PARP) and proteins related to the signaling pathway(ETS-1, CIP2 A, and Akt) were detected by Western blot. The binding sites of PPA to ETS-1 were analyzed by molecular docking. The affinity of PPA and ETS-1 was detected by drug affinity responsive target stability(DARTS) assay. PPA had a significant inhibitory effect on the proliferation and colony formation of GC cells at a low concentration. The PPA groups showed increased ROS and decreased mitochondrial membrane potential. PPA down-regulated the precursor expression of caspase-9 and caspase-3 and promoted the cleavage of PARP, suggesting that PPA induced the apoptosis of GC cells through the mitochondrial pathway. PPA significantly reduced expression levels of CIP2 A and the phosphorylation of downstream Akt. Molecular docking showed that PPA bound to the ETS domain of ETS-1, the transcription factor of CIP2 A, and formed hydrogen bonds with Pro319 and Asp317. DARTS assay further confirmed that PPA significantly prevented the hydrolysis of ETS-1 by pronase, which was inductive of the direct binding effect of PPA and ETS-1. PPA inhibits the proliferation and induces the apoptosis of GC cells by directly targeting ETS-1 to down-regulate the ETS-1/CIP2 A/Akt signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了重楼皂苷A（PPA）抑制胃癌（GC）细胞的机制。以不同浓度的PPA处理GC细胞（SGC7901和MGC803细胞系）。分别通过MTT实验、实时细胞分析（RTCA）实验和克隆形成实验检测PPA对GC细胞增殖的影响。通过流式细胞术检测GC细胞的活性氧（ROS）。通过JC-1实验检测线粒体膜电位的变化。通过Western blot检测凋亡相关蛋白（caspase-9、caspase-3和PARP）及信号通路相关蛋白（ETS-1、CIP2A和Akt）的表达和磷酸化水平。通过分子对接分析PPA与ETS-1的结合位点。通过药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）实验检测PPA与ETS-1的亲和力。低浓度PPA对GC细胞的增殖和集落形成具有显著抑制作用。PPA组显示ROS增加，线粒体膜电位降低。PPA下调caspase-9和caspase-3的前体表达，并促进PARP的裂解，表明PPA通过线粒体途径诱导GC细胞凋亡。PPA显著降低CIP2A的表达水平及下游Akt的磷酸化。分子对接显示，PPA与CIP2A的转录因子ETS-1的ETS结构域结合，并与Pro319和Asp317形成氢键。DARTS实验进一步证实，PPA显著阻止了pronase对ETS-1的水解，这提示PPA与ETS-1具有直接结合效应。PPA通过直接靶向ETS-1下调ETS-1/CIP2A/Akt信号通路，从而抑制GC细胞增殖并诱导其凋亡。
